source.title: C语言 数论与大数运算，一组笔记讲清楚
source.author: C语言模型笔记📝

scope.zh-CN: 9张图片顺序及跨页续接核对；4张关键代码/样例页按原分辨率抽查。未编译运行。
scope.en: Order and continuation checked across all nine images; four critical code/example pages reviewed at original resolution. No compilation or execution.

observation.zh-CN: 原图是 l = -l，字母 l 被模型误读为数字1；相关错误批评已撤回。
observation.en: The original shows l = -l; the model confused letter l with digit 1. The resulting incorrect criticism was withdrawn.

observation.zh-CN: 函数调用第三参数是 mod，没有模型额外添加的 &。
observation.en: The third call argument is mod, without the ampersand invented by the model.

observation.zh-CN: 进制转换页可见基数范围及十六进制样例；只做静态观察。
observation.en: The base-conversion page shows its radix range and a hexadecimal example; this was static observation only.

observation.zh-CN: 减法结尾页展示负号和零结果处理；没有运行该程序。
observation.en: The subtraction ending shows sign and zero-result handling; the program was not run.

publication.zh-CN: 经宿主修订的公共摘要；不含原媒体、完整转写或完整代码。
publication.en: Public summary of the host-corrected result; no original media, full transcript or full code.

summary.zh-CN: 笔记覆盖数论基础、模运算、进制转换和非负大整数加减；公共摘要展示原图复核如何纠正代码识别错误。
summary.en: The notes cover number theory basics, modular operations, base conversion and nonnegative large-integer arithmetic. This summary demonstrates how original-image review corrected code-reading errors.

corrections.zh-CN: l=-1 修正为 l=-l，并撤回由误读产生的推断。
corrections.en: Corrected l=-1 to l=-l and withdrew the inference caused by that misreading.

corrections.zh-CN: 移除 mod 参数前虚构的 &。
corrections.en: Removed the invented & before the mod argument.

corrections.zh-CN: 静态图文没有语音时间轴，按图片序号定位；这不是ASR失败。
corrections.en: Static images are located by image order, without a speech timeline; this is not an ASR failure.

zh-CN: 本机实测，不代表异机或所有作品可用。
模型原始输出可能有错，公共摘要以宿主修订后的报告和复核记录为准。

en: Local evidence does not establish other-device or universal-work support.
Original model output may be wrong; this summary follows the host-corrected report and review.
Submitted quantities describe this run, not fixed cost, speed or settled billing.
